delivery_status: Published as ed036aae5499ce39b58328071356a7511fee1b24 with the exact original tested implementation tree. No forced history replacement.

implementation_scope.InitializeWithSdkVersion: Exact header/CallingPid descriptor. Bind kernel caller PID and trusted single-program host ID to each new FS session. SDK version retained for diagnostics only; pinned HLE does not apply compatibility logic.
implementation_scope.host_program_id: 00040000000AD500 from supported_revision.json; runner is fixed to the verified game image, not a multi-program loader.
implementation_scope.pid_placeholder: Ignored as required by kernel CallerPid translation semantics. No general IPC descriptor translator added; this narrowly resolves the initialization caller.
implementation_scope.priority: Pinned FS_USER module-global u32, default 0xFFFFFFFF. SetPriority stores it across sessions. No thread-priority or filesystem worker scheduling effect.
implementation_scope.session_factory: Opt-in IpcService::CreateSessionHandler supplies a fresh per-connection FS endpoint. Null keeps existing APT/NDM shared-handler policy. DuplicateHandle refers to the same original session.
implementation_scope.unsupported: Older Initialize, GetPriority, archive/file commands, malformed requests and priority before initialization remain explicit host stops.
implementation_scope.no_filesystem_io: No archive mounting, file reads, writes, save success or directory enumeration implemented or claimed.
